split_scope: Published viewer assignment for this snapshot; no per-policy train/test assignment is present in YAML
success_rule: Decode the explicit policies.<id>.binary_success integer 0/1 only; no derivation from completion or quality
completion_rule: Copy policies.<id>.partial_success unchanged, as an episode-level [0,1] annotation
quality_rule: null: no quality_label category supplied by this original collection
task_id_rule: null: no stable semantic task ID supplied
execution_rule: Copy the exact source policy-directory locator; original folder explicitly groups one policy rollout, camera views and state file
family_rule: Self trajectory ID; provisional derivation family, no cross-dataset identity claims
leakage_rule: Conservative session-level group from explicit shared source session; final cross-dataset deduplication remains unresolved
camera_rule: One original primary video per policy episode, prefer left, then right, then wrist; preserve other original camera locators as remote refs
time_rule: Preserve original session timestamps in source; per-frame physical timestamps and camera/state sync remain null
state_rule: Reference original NPZ data object-array without changing values; non-executing reader validates each numeric field and its original shape; retain sample order without assumed video alignment
duration_rule: Copy raw duration unchanged. Historical evaluator code uploads t_step from a zero-based control loop. Its meaning is the final control-step index; all 4,613 NPZ sample counts equal duration + 1. It is not elapsed seconds.
attribution_rule: Copy evaluator_name and evaluation_location with YAML field references; do not invent new user IDs or feedback events
unmapped_rule: Keep complete immutable YAML, including preferences and feedback; list unmapped fields, create no new preference labels
